## Professional Profile

## Featured Projects

### UK Road Collision Analysis
[*GitHub*](https://github.com/aguchhait-stack/UK_road_safety) | [*PDF Report*](https://github.com/aguchhait-stack/UK_road_safety/raw/main/outputs/Collision.pdf)

A comprehensive statistical analysis of over 100,000 road collision records to identify key environmental factors influencing accident severity.

- **Impact**: Quantified predictive relationships between weather conditions, road types, and collision outcomes
- **Engineering**: Designed scalable data models transforming raw records into analysis-ready research subsets
- **Analysis**: Applied hypothesis testing (t-tests, ANOVA) and regression modeling to validate safety variables
